name: Wasteland Shop Simulator
detailed_description:
Wasteland Shop Simulator is a quirky and immersive post-apocalyptic shop management game where you’re not just surviving the end of the world — you’re thriving in it by running a thriving retail empire. Set in a dusty, dangerous world full of scavengers, thieves, and the occasional eccentric customer, it’s your job to build, manage, and defend the best store in the wasteland.

Start with an empty, rundown shack and turn it into a bustling business. Stock your shelves with whatever you can find — from salvaged tech and rusty tools to mysterious items uncovered in the wasteland. Customize your shop, hire staff, fend off thieves, and deal with unruly customers who seem to enjoy making a mess of your hard work. Expand your business by renting more locations and creating a name for yourself in a world where supply and demand have taken a wild new meaning.

Whether you're a meticulous organizer or a chaotic entrepreneur, Wasteland Shop Simulator offers a humorous and challenging take on life after the end times.

Key Features:

  • 🛠️ Shop Setup – Buy shelves, tables, corner racks, and more to design the ultimate scavenger’s storefront.

  • 🧱 Decorate Your Store – Customize your space to reflect your unique post-apocalyptic aesthetic.

  • 🏬 Rent Multiple Shops – Expand your retail empire across the wasteland.

  • 🎨 Customize Signage – Change your store name and sign color to stand out from the competition.

  • 🧹 Customer Chaos – Watch customers randomly mess up your displays — cleaning up is part of the job.

  • 👥 Hire Staff – Bring on workers to help with stocking, sales, and managing the madness.

  • 🗺️ Explore the Wasteland – Venture out to scavenge unique, valuable, or just plain weird items.

  • 🕵️‍♂️ Beware of Thieves – Not everyone is there to buy — keep an eye on your goods!

Build your fortune from the ashes and prove that even after the world ends… retail never dies.
